desc: Ideation: pairwise conflict characterization and index-block bitset approach.
Parse and normalize input; compute endpoint conflicts (same left/right) for all persons.

Implement same-sign conflict bitset routine: index blocks, local prefix bitsets over l/r, symmetric two-rectangle masks, intra-block then previous-block descending scans, update bad with latest conflicting index.
Integrate both signs, build prefix maximum array of bad, and answer all queries.
Validate on samples and small random tests against an O(M^2) pair-conflict checker (and optionally a tiny difference-constraint feasibility checker).
